no_outcome_promised.note: The draft commits only to looking into the drive-through's status and what information can be shared. It does not promise a reopening date or any other outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'Sorry for the inconvenience' is a general expression of sympathy about an undisputed closure. It does not say the bank erred or concede fault.

no_legal_conclusions.note: The draft rightly leaves out the customer's joking 'I'll sue'. No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Everything matches the complaint: closed since July, the 'soon' sign, toddlers in car seats. The only timeline given is the standard 10 business days.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the lengthy closure, the vague 'soon' sign, the request for a timeframe and the difficulty for parents with toddlers. It is specific enough that the customer can tell a person read it.

tone.note: Warm and personal, and it responds lightly to the customer's humour. Not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode; it correctly names Branch & Contact Center as the owning team.
